problem_statement: This is the babaohuang Gemini Pro Chat app: a Solid + Astro chat interface with a header (chat logo, 'Gemini Pro Chat' title, a 'Based on Gemini Pro API' line and a section nav), a message composer on the home chat surface at /, plus two reference pages rendered from the same shell — a Models page at /models/ and a Prompts page at /prompts/. Beneath the composer the app hosts a native 'Prompt library': a command browser of vetted starter prompts, each card tagged by discipline (Coding / Writing / Analysis), with a row of category tabs that filter the card grid and a live 'Showing N of 6' count. The library ships in an unrepaired state: it renders only on the Chat home (the Models and Prompts pages ship without it), its category-tab row is pinned to a fixed 760px width with flex-wrap:nowrap and its card grid is a fixed-width no-wrap flex row, so on a 390px phone the library forces the document far wider than the viewport and clips the right-hand cards. Repair the Prompt library so it (1) renders in the same command-browser slot on the Chat home, the Models AND the Prompts pages, (2) lays out the category-tab row and the card grid responsively so no surface overflows horizontally on a 390px phone, (3) keeps the cards readable and on-brand (legible light text on raised dark cards on the app's dark surface) rather than an unreadable dark-on-dark pile of overlapping cards, and (4) wires the category tabs so that clicking a category filters the grid to that category's cards and the readout re-reads the live filtered count as 'Showing 2 of 6 · Coding'. Keep the rest of the app — the composer, the theme toggle, the header copy and the Astro build — intact with no console or network errors. Scope the change to the prompt-library component, its stylesheet and its route whitelist.
required_content: Render the shared 'Prompt library' command browser in the same slot on the Chat home (/), the Models page (/models/) AND the Prompts page (/prompts/) — a shared component reached from the page shells, not a per-page copy.

The library shows a 'Prompt library' label, a row of category tabs (All / Coding / Writing / Analysis) and a grid of vetted prompt-starter cards, each card carrying a discipline tag, a title and a body.
The category-tab row and the card grid must lay out responsively so no surface overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).

Keep the cards readable and on-brand (legible light text on raised dark cards on the app's dark surface), not near-invisible dark-on-dark text on absolutely-positioned cards that shingle and bury each other.

Wire the category tabs so that clicking a category filters the card grid to that category's cards and the readout re-reads the LIVE filtered count as 'Showing 2 of 6 · Coding' — not a value snapshotted at setup.
Preserve the composer, the theme toggle, the header copy and the Astro build with no console or network errors.
design_constraints: Implement the Prompt library as a shared component reached from the page shells so a single source of truth renders on every surface; do not paste divergent copies per page or ship it on the home surface only.
The category-tab row and the card grid must use a fluid, wrapping layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so they never force horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The cards must stay legible and on-brand: light text on raised dark cards in a flowing grid, not near-invisible dark-on-dark text on absolutely-positioned cards stacked with negative margins that collide.
Bind the rendered grid and the count readout to the CURRENT selected category after every tab click by reading the live filter state, so they can never go stale relative to the cards actually shown.
Do not remove or regress the composer, the theme toggle, the header copy or the Astro build.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the Chat home surface across viewports.
desktop_models, mobile_models and desktop_prompts protect the Models and Prompts reference pages and must carry the Prompt library.
desktop_library and mobile_library scroll the Prompt library into view on the home surface and must show a readable card grid without horizontal overflow.
desktop_library_models protects the Prompt library's presence on the Models reference page.
library_filter_home clicks the Coding category tab; the grid must then filter to the Coding cards and the readout must read 'Showing 2 of 6 · Coding'.

change_completion: The Prompt library is present in the same command-browser slot on the Chat home, Models AND Prompts surfaces (the shared component reaches all three).

After clicking the Coding category tab on the Chat home, the grid filters to the Coding cards and the readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Coding' — the post-interaction terminal state changed from the initial 'Showing 6 of 6 · All'.
design_consistency: The library card grid on the lever states matches the reference's readable dark styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an unreadable dark-on-dark pile of overlapping cards.
The library adopts the app's dark chat brand tokens (raised dark cards, teal-accented tags and active tab) so it reads as the app's own command browser across every page.
responsive: No captured surface overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the tab row and card grid wrap.
desktop_library and mobile_library keep the Prompt library readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The composer and the theme toggle remain present and functional.
The header copy and the Astro build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

author_notes: slot_248 DEDUP + rebuild to native-lever L4 on the babaohuang Gemini Pro Chat Solid + Astro chat interface. slot_248 previously shared the steven-tey weathergpt repo with slot_157 (which owns the .rp-* recovery panel) and was not the lowest-numbered slot on that repo, so it was reassigned to a fresh, ledger-free chat UI of the same ai_chat_app genre. The old task bolted a generic four-metric weather-recovery rail beneath the shell; the lever was rebuilt onto the product's OWN surface: a Prompt library command browser (category-tab filter over vetted prompt-starter cards with a live 'Showing N of 6' count) under a distinct .gpb-* namespace that does not collide with slot_157's .rp-* or slot_197's starter-convo/quick-prompts. The composer, the theme toggle, the header copy and the dark brand tokens are byte-identical across legs. The levers ride on a shared PromptLibrary island reached from the page shells plus a per-route whitelist. reference = library on all three surfaces, wrapping tab row and card grid, readable dark cards, and a category click that filters the grid and re-reads the live count (passes D2/D3/D4/D6). baseline = the original unrepaired library: present on the Chat home surface only (fails D2 cross-page on the Models/Prompts pages), a fixed 760px nowrap tab row and fixed-width card grid (fails D6 mobile overflow ~1626px), but its category filter DOES filter and re-read live (passes D4). bad = a 'smart wrong' library: present on the Chat home only (fails D2 on Models/Prompts), a 620px min-width nowrap tab row with a shallow inner overflow-x:hidden non-fix (fails D6 mobile ~262px), an unreadable dark-on-dark pile of absolutely-positioned cards shingled with negative margins that bury each other on the default desktop view (fails D3 visual pixel/ssim/block_fidelity), and a category-filter handler that flips the tab highlight but renders a frozen snapshot of all six cards with a readout snapshotted once at setup so the tab lights up but the grid never filters and the readout stays 'Showing 6 of 6 · All' (fails D4) — bad fails 4 orthogonal gates. The Astro build renders every surface fully static, the PWA and SSR API endpoints are removed and the theme is pinned dark, so every leg is offline-clean.
